lines.text: Division
in boxes of three dfferent sizes. Find the number of boxes required if:
. 10 masks can be packed in small box.
100 masks can be packed in medium box.
. 1,000 masks can bed packed in large box.
To find the required number of boxes,
we will divide the total number of masks
by 10, 100 and 1,000 respectively.

Key Fact
When we divide a whole number 0 at its ones place by 10, we remove
one zero from the right side of the number.
When we divide a whole number 0 at its ones and tens place by 100,
we remove two zeros from the right of the number.
When we divide a whole number having O in its ones, tens and
hundreds place by 1,o0o, weremove three zeros from the right of the
number.
